articles.title: The Garden Above the Hospital
articles.text: When a city hospital proposed a garden above its intermediate care floor, some officials called it an expensive possibility. A nurse about to retire argued that patients needed contact with the ground and seasons after months of collective loss. The devil was in the engineering details: soil weight, drainage, and safe access all required the hospital to invest carefully. It opened a year later, and families used the quiet space to talk beyond the sound of medical machines.
articles.translation: 一家市医院提议在中级护理楼层上方建花园时，一些官员认为这只是昂贵的设想。一名即将退休的护士认为，在共同经历数月失落后，患者需要接触土地和四季。难点藏在工程细节中：土壤重量、排水和安全通行都要求医院谨慎投资。一年后花园开放，家属们在这片安静空间里交谈，暂时远离医疗机器的声音。

articles.title: How Crystals Take Shape
articles.text: A crystal grows when a large number of atoms join a repeating pattern instead of settling with complete freedom. Temperature and concentration guide the pattern; frequent disturbance can block growth or produce many small forms. In a firm research headquarters, scientists change one condition at a time because everything from dust to vibration may affect the result. They conclude that structure matters only after images and measurements agree across repeated experiments.
articles.translation: 大量原子按重复图案结合，而不是完全自由地排列时，晶体就会生长。温度与浓度引导这种图案；频繁扰动会阻碍生长，或形成许多小晶体。在严谨的研究总部，科学家一次只改变一个条件，因为从灰尘到振动的一切都可能影响结果。只有图像与测量在重复实验中一致时，他们才得出结构规律的结论。

articles.title: Retirement Should Include Real Choice
articles.text: An impressive retirement village may advertise a perfect lodge, regular concerts, and comfortable rooms to anyone over fifty. Yet each candidate should ask whether the place can fit changing health needs and whether family may stay overnight. Good performance figures mean little if they exclude residents who left for care elsewhere or if every service except basic comfort costs extra. Older people deserve clear contracts and the freedom to compare ownership, rental, and community options before deciding.
articles.translation: 一座亮眼的退休社区可能向五十岁以上的人宣传完美小屋、定期音乐会和舒适房间。但每位申请者都应询问这里能否适应不断变化的健康需求，以及家人能否留宿。如果数据排除了去别处接受护理的住户，或除基本舒适外每项服务都额外收费，再好的业绩数字也意义有限。老年人在决定前应获得清楚合同，并能自由比较产权、租赁与社区等选择。
